newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Trade, economic cooperation and transit issues may dominate discussions at the Bangladesh-India Joint Economic Commission (JEC) meeting due in New Delhi on March 12.
The government has decided to set up a Human Rights Commission for "promotion of human rights", said Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Minister Abdul Matin Khasru.
A formal announcement on repatriation of Bangladeshi tribal refugees from the Indian state of Tripura is likely to be made on Sunday.
South African President Nelson Mandela and Turkish Presaident Suleiman Demirel will be among the dignitaries to attend the silver jubilee celebrations of the country's independence on March 26.
A three-day fair of British products and services begins in Dhaka on Sunday.
Nearly 9,000 pilgrims from Bangladesh will perform the holy Hajj this year, due on April 15, under government arrangement.
Eight developing muslim countries - Bangladesh, Pakistan, Egypt, Nigeria, Turkey, Iran, Malaysian and Indonesia - are expected to launch a new economic bloc by the middle of this year.
A understanding to establish a multi designed socks industry in Bangladesh was signed on Wednesday in Tokyo between Japan's Taisho Fiber Company Ltd and a Bangladeshi enterprise.
